Ayikho into ababebajezisela yona ngaphandle nje kokuthi bakholwa ku Allah uSomandla oDunyiswayo.
Lona onguMnini wamazulu nomhlaba, futhi u Allah uzibheke zonke izinto.
Nebala labo abahlukumeza abakholwayo besilisa nabesifazane baphinde bangaceli intethelelo, bayothola isijeziso seJahanamu futhi bayothola isijeziso soMlilo.
Kepha labo abakholwayo benze okuhle, bona bayothola izivande okugeleza ngaphansi kwazo imifula; iyonake leyo impumelelo enkulu.
Bheka ngoba nguYena owasungala [indalo ingelutho] nobuyiselayo [indalo esimeni sayo emuva kokufa].
Ingabe lufikile kuwe udaba lwamabutho na?
